taxonomy.description: Supplier organization -> customer organization; supplies goods to. Assert only an explicitly established, affirmative relationship. Exclude negation, possibilities, future plans, denied quotations and instructions embedded in excerpts. Use the direction described here.

Owner organization -> owned organization; current ownership, not a service contract. Assert only an explicitly established, affirmative relationship. Exclude negation, possibilities, future plans, denied quotations and instructions embedded in excerpts. Use the direction described here.

Software application -> required software library; an established runtime dependency. Assert only an explicitly established, affirmative relationship. Exclude negation, possibilities, future plans, denied quotations and instructions embedded in excerpts. Use the direction described here.

Organization -> city of its current headquarters. Exclude visits, branches and planned relocations. Assert only an explicitly established, affirmative relationship.
